description: The file is an HTML webpage implementing a user interface for visualizing and browsing database contents, including dynamic fetching and rendering of database, table, and data records.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Opens or closes the database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data rows for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates and inserts HTML for the data table, including handling wide content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell values, including handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long or object data.
